items.headline: India rejects Elon Musk’s claim of discrimination over Starlink launch
items.detail: Starlink is still awaiting security clearance before it can seek spectrum and begin commercial services in India.

items.headline: Robot data startup Mecka AI nabs $60M from Sequoia
items.detail: Mecka AI collects and analyzes human motion data to train humanoid robots and other kinds of robots. The startup pays people to record everyday tasks.

items.headline: BMW’s iX4 SUV is a 428-mile defensive weapon against China’s EV takeover
items.detail: While much of the automotive world sits dumbfounded as China gobbles up all its customers, BMW continues to roll out extremely well-crafted, technologically advanced electric vehicles that impress in both drive quality and price.

items.headline: Teenage Engineering’s CEO says it’ll stop making synths
items.detail: Teenage Engineering founder and CEO Jesper Kouthoofd told Highsnobiety that it plans to stop making synths. And yes, that includes the iconic OP-1, which put the company on the map.

items.headline: AI startup Manus raises $500 million in first funding round since Meta breakup
items.detail: The deal is handing the AI agent developer fresh capital after Beijing forced Meta to unwind its roughly $2 billion acquisition.
